einzeiler: Recapping Supernatural season 9, episode 15 with writer Jenny Klein.
kurzfassung: The hosts break down the episode "Hashtag Thin Man" alongside writer Jenny Klein, discussing the return of the Ghostfacers and the internet legend that inspired the plot. They examine the parallel relationship struggles between the Winchester brothers and the ghost-hunting duo. The conversation also explores Klein's journey from production assistant to showrunner.
stichpunkte: Discussion of season nine, episode 15, "Hashtag Thin Man" and its eerie teaser scene.
The arrival of the Ghostfacers and the comedic friction among the four characters.
A major plot twist involving human killers operating under the Thin Man persona.
Writer Jenny Klein joins as a guest to share her career origin story on the show.
Insights into the writer's room dynamics and the rare longevity of working on Supernatural.
Exploring the real-world internet hoax, Slenderman, that inspired the episode's monster.
Reviewing previous Supernatural episodes featuring human villains rather than supernatural entities.

clips.hook: Bully dynamics in the diner scene
clips.text: The hosts point out how aggressive and uncharacteristically mean the Winchester brothers act toward the amateur ghost hunters during their initial confrontation.

clips.hook: From hospital job to writer's room
clips.text: The guest explains how she transitioned from working in cardiology at a county hospital to landing a job as a writer's assistant on the series.
The conversation takes a humorous turn as the participants stumble over and dissect an unfamiliar internet slang term related to online horror stories.
The guest jokingly reflects on her past work with intense self-criticism while discussing the constraints she faced as a junior staff writer at the time.
The hosts look up audience and critic scores for a feature film adaptation and deliver a punchline involving a famous actor's name.

beschreibung:
Writer Jenny Klein joins the podcast for this scary episode of Supernatural. Hear her story about starting as a writer production assistant, the origins of this idea, and her trips to set. She really gets sad about breaking up the Ghostfacers! Rob and Rich learn about Slender Man and Creepy Pasta.
